subject: meta: Fix vector incompatibility with old version and TiFlash (#60719)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it only changes metadata semantics via `ast.IndexType` iota ordering (and a comment). `IndexTypeVector` is moved to value `5` (previously `IndexTypeHNSW`), keeping the persisted `IndexInfo.Tp` numeric stable for pre-existing vector indexes and aligning with TiFlash; `IndexTypeInverted` remains `6` and other legacy values are unchanged. Confirmed `IndexType` is JSON-serialized as an integer (no custom marshal), and callers primarily key off `VectorInfo`/`InvertedInfo` for columnar behavior. Checked `upstream/master`: the same ordering remains, so no later “fix” changes the conclusion.
